chapter: On the road with Duke and his bandmates
title: The 'Bula' opera and Ko-Ko
summary: He knows nothing about Duke's planned opera Bula or its material in Ko-Ko and Black, Brown and Beige.

story.theme_name: Playing for dancers: dance bands and the dances themselves
story.community_name: Dancing to the band: quadrilles, waltzes and dance sets

blocks.x: Okay. I understand from Barry Ulanov's "Ko-Ko" book that Ceecea came from an opera Duke was writing called "Bula".
I say I read in Barry Ulanov's book that the piece "Ko-Ko" came from an opera Duke was writing that he called "Bula". Do you remember Bula?
No, I don't know anything about that.
And he said that when he wrote "Black, Brown and Beige," he took some of the material that he was planning to use in "Bula," and put it in "Black, Brown and Beige."
Well, I don't know about that. No, I don't know a thing about that.
Because that would've been what? The 1943 concert, I think.
